# Noto Sans Symbols 2

Twelve Ranks uses this font only as the editable source for its standard chess
piece silhouettes.

- Source: https://notofonts.github.io/symbols/
- Downloaded file: `NotoSansSymbols2-Regular.ttf`
- SHA-256: `E765DA63D6AB05ADEFB811C9DE055C79001DDCC3DF3E2636C86A01EBF202C1E8`
- Copyright: 2022 The Noto Project Authors
- License: SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (`OFL.txt`)

The generated SVG assets are derived from the filled chess glyphs at
U+265A through U+265F and remain subject to the SIL Open Font License.
